The mapped outline that point names becomes the domain; a domain supplied directly supersedes it, and a body nobody mapped is drawn [supplied on this invocation]

Hypolimnion (cold bottom layer) temperature; the initial top-to-bottom difference is what the run either keeps or mixes away [supplied on this invocation]
